name: What is involved in a custom kitchen design-build project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a custom kitchen design-build project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom kitchen design-build project with AKN Design Group unifies the entire renovation process from concept to completion. It begins with comprehensive design planning, including CAD-supported layouts, material selection, and permit coordination. We then transition into construction, managing all trades, installations, and inspections. Our integrated approach ensures a single point of coordination, streamlining communication and accountability. This managed process is designed to transform a dated layout into a functional entertaining space, enhancing both the beauty and utility of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our custom kitchen design-build process integrates design planning, material selection, permit coordination, and construction under a single point of accountability from concept to completion.
